svg.aria-label: What I build, assembled live by a swarm of design cursors: websites for businesses; frontend with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Angular; mobile apps with React Native and Expo; backend with Python, FastAPI, Node and Express; databases with PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostGIS, SQLite and Firebase; AI features with Gemini and LangGraph.
